summary: Issue: entitlement to maintenance under Sections 24 and 25 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 in void marriage cases; conflicting precedents exist; reference made to Three Judge Bench due to divergence on whether alimony can be awarded when marriage is declared void ab initio; arguments examined on spouse's status, legitimacy of claim, and equity; no final determination by this Bench.
final_judgment: Matter referred to a Bench of three Judges for resolution of conflicting views on applicability of Sections 24 and 25 to void marriages.
